purpose: Provide stable business data concepts that connect source fields, procedures, reference datasets, validation hints and discovery evidence.
rules: A concept has stable meaning, not only aliases.
A source binding is contextual evidence, not universal equality.
Representation normalization must not silently change business identity.
Cross-system value conversion belongs to governed reference data when identifiers differ.
Semantic drift can exist even when column names and types do not change.
Promote concepts only when meaning is stable enough to reuse.

integration_points.discovery: Use approved bindings, aliases and representation hints as evidence.
integration_points.mapping: Shared concept references strengthen candidates but do not replace cardinality checks.
integration_points.validation: Concepts may provide reusable validation hints.
integration_points.catalog: Index consumed and produced concepts for capability search.
integration_points.reference_data: Reference datasets connect different governed value spaces.
integration_points.ai: Retrieve approved concepts before asking a model to infer semantics.
